name: drupal/audit_chain
description: Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit logging for any Drupal module — optional HMAC signing, at-rest encryption, prefix seal for historical segments, and independent verification.

suggest.drupal/charts: Optional: upgrades the reports dashboard inline-SVG charts to interactive charts (install a library submodule such as charts_chartjs). The dashboard keeps the SVG fallback when Charts is absent or has no library.
